name: COMP_021
markdown:
## Bottom line
**Suggests Benign (92%)** · Confident · Careful review
Conformal set is single-class, but neighbors split and the simulated margin call says tumor.

## Confidence
| Signal | Value | Reading |
|---|---|---|
| Top probabilities | Benign 92%, Normal 5%, InSitu 3%, Invasive 1% | Clear Benign lead |
| Conformal set | {Benign} at 90% | Single class |
| Reliability / OOD | 1.00 / 88th percentile | Reliable; somewhat atypical |
| Second-model (MUSK) agreement | Agrees | Independent model concurs |
| Similar cases | 2 of 5 Benign | Weak support; 3 InSitu |

## Tissue evidence
- **Normal lobules** (regions 0, 4, 8) · ↓ invasive · Largest negative term in concept model [F2] · Unreliable
- **Lymphocytic infiltrate** (region 10) · context · Negative term, descriptive only [F3] · Weak
- **Benign stroma or fat** (regions 0, 4) · ↓ invasive · Associated with lower invasive likelihood [F4] · Validated
- **Mitotic figures** (regions 3, 6, 11) · ↑ invasive · Positive term; spot check failed · Unreliable
- **Tumor-infiltrating stroma** (region 4) · ↑ invasive · Small positive term · Validated

## Trust check
- **Heatmap**: Removing the top 3 regions drops the invasive logit 0.54 more than random (CI 0.47–0.60); faithful.
- **Concepts**: Deletion CI (−0.005 to 0.007) includes 0; not shown to reflect the classifier. This case leans on Unreliable normal lobules and mitoses.

## Could be wrong if
- Regions 2, 7, 11 hold invasive tumor the image-level call dilutes (probe risk 88%, 74%, 95%).
- The simulated superior-margin tumor call is right; only 2 of 5 neighbors back Benign.

## Check on the slide
1. **6, 10, 11**: Strongest heatmap push toward invasive; confirm no carcinoma.
2. **2**: Simulated superior margin flagged tumor (108 µm); verify directly.
3. **0, 4, 8**: Confirm normal lobules; their concept spot check was 0/20.
